selectors.title: Random exploration
selectors.hypothesis: A random but reproducible sample is a strong unbiased control.

selectors.title: Top current-retriever candidates
selectors.hypothesis: Exploit the current retriever's highest-scoring documents.

selectors.title: Uniform rank coverage
selectors.hypothesis: Spread labels across the whole candidate ranking instead of only its head.

selectors.title: Head–tail mixture
selectors.hypothesis: Label both likely positives/hard negatives and clear negatives.

selectors.title: Lexical-first selection
selectors.hypothesis: Spend feedback on BM25's strongest candidates.

selectors.title: Semantic-first selection
selectors.hypothesis: Spend feedback on latent-semantic candidates.

selectors.title: Character-robust selection
selectors.hypothesis: Favor candidates supported by character-level similarity.

selectors.title: Title-focused selection
selectors.hypothesis: Favor concise title evidence before full-document evidence.

selectors.title: Multi-retriever consensus
selectors.hypothesis: Reward candidates jointly supported by several retrievers.

selectors.title: Retriever disagreement
selectors.hypothesis: Label pairs on which lexical, character and semantic retrievers disagree.

selectors.title: Current-model uncertainty
selectors.hypothesis: Label candidates nearest the current model's decision boundary.

selectors.title: Bootstrap committee disagreement
selectors.hypothesis: Use epistemic disagreement across cheap student replicas.

selectors.title: Likely false-positive hunting
selectors.hypothesis: Inspect high-ranked candidates the current model distrusts.

selectors.title: Likely false-negative hunting
selectors.hypothesis: Inspect low-ranked candidates the current model considers promising.

selectors.title: Query-term coverage
selectors.hypothesis: Prefer documents covering more of the query's content.

selectors.title: Rank-stratified sampling
selectors.hypothesis: Guarantee supervision from each rank band.

selectors.title: Relevance–diversity MMR
selectors.hypothesis: Balance likely relevance with non-redundant documents.

selectors.title: Uncertainty–diversity MMR
selectors.hypothesis: Cover multiple uncertain semantic regions.

selectors.title: Semantic k-center coverage
selectors.hypothesis: Cover the candidate manifold with farthest-first traversal.

selectors.title: Candidate-cluster representatives
selectors.hypothesis: Take representative documents from multiple semantic clusters.

selectors.title: Typical–outlier mixture
selectors.hypothesis: Label both dense-region representatives and unusual candidates.

selectors.title: Hard-negative proxy
selectors.hypothesis: Prioritize high retrieval score but low relevance probability.

selectors.title: Feature-space leverage
selectors.hypothesis: Select statistically influential examples in the student feature space.

selectors.title: D-optimal experimental design
selectors.hypothesis: Choose a set that maximizes feature-space information volume.

selectors.title: Diversified policy portfolio
selectors.hypothesis: Hedge across exploitation, uncertainty, disagreement, coverage and diversity.

allocations.title: Uniform per-query budget
allocations.hypothesis: Give every query the same number of feedback calls.

allocations.title: Difficulty-adaptive budget
allocations.hypothesis: Allocate more labels to low-confidence/high-entropy queries.

allocations.title: Disagreement-adaptive budget
allocations.hypothesis: Allocate more labels where retrievers and model replicas disagree.

allocations.title: Topic-balanced budget
allocations.hypothesis: Equalize total feedback across query clusters, not raw query counts.
